role: The JDK 8 HashMap order emulation for a Long-keyed map (MapGenStructure.structureMap): tail-append put, the resize that splits each chain into low and high halves in chain order, and bucket-ascending iteration. The ChunkPosition-keyed set the explosion used is jorder.c's computed order now (lane/gpuorder, L4).

structs.name: jhm64_node
structs.java: java.util.HashMap.Node for a Long key (JDK class)

gpu: jhm64_init and jhm64_put: calloc of the table and malloc of one node per new key; chains of heap pointers. It serves worldgen's structure map (populate.c, populate_nether.c), outside L4's list; the explosion's ChunkPosition set moved to jorder.c (lane/gpuorder, L4)
notes: The iter and iter_n fields of struct jhm are initialised and freed but never filled by jhashmap.c. Users: explosion.c (jhm), populate.c, populate_nether.c and serverreplay.c (jhm64).
